story: An icon of the skies, the Silver Pheasant (Lophura nycthemera) is a species from the Phasianidae family. It thrives in Forests; mainly in mountains; evergreen broadleaf forest; and valley rainforest, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Silver Pheasant is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Silver Pheasant helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Silver Pheasant, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
